    # Replicate the nonblank tile found in the bottom-left compartment into
    # every compartment, preserving separator rows and columns.
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep = 6
    rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == sep for v in grid[r])]
    cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == sep for r in range(h))]
    # Find rectangular compartments between full separator lines.
    rb = [-1] + rows + [h]
    cb = [-1] + cols + [w]
    rsegments = [(rb[i] + 1, rb[i+1]) for i in range(len(rb)-1)]
    csegments = [(cb[i] + 1, cb[i+1]) for i in range(len(cb)-1)]
    # The bottom-left compartment is the source motif.
    r0, r1 = rsegments[-1]
    c0, c1 = csegments[0]
    tile = [row[c0:c1] for row in grid[r0:r1]]
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for rs, re in rsegments:
        for cs, ce in csegments:
            if re-rs != len(tile) or ce-cs != len(tile[0]):
                continue
            for i in range(len(tile)):
                out[rs+i][cs:ce] = tile[i][:]
    return out
